let QueryStart = datetime(${__from:date});
let QueryEnd = datetime(${__to:date});
set best_effort=true;
let EnableLiveArgEnrichment = true;
let EnableAipddEnrichment = false;
let RawFinishedJobs = materialize(
    cluster('https://adx.monitor.azure.com/subscriptions/31347be8-d066-464e-9866-7e58d85027b7/resourcegroups/azcopy-telemetry-test-rg/providers/microsoft.insights/components/azcopy-telemetry-test-ai').database('azcopy-telemetry-test-ai').customEvents
    | where timestamp between (QueryStart .. QueryEnd)
    | where name == 'azcopy.job.finished'
    | where tostring(customDimensions.SchemaVersion) in ('2', '3')
    | extend
        JobID = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions.JobID, customDimensions.RunID, customDimensions.InvocationID)),
        InstallationIDValue = tostring(customDimensions.InstallationID),
        InvocationContextValue = tostring(customDimensions.InvocationContext),
        AzCopyVersionValue = tostring(customDimensions.AzCopyVersion),
        OSTypeValue = tostring(customDimensions.OSType),
        SourceTypeValue = tostring(customDimensions.SourceType),
        DestTypeValue = tostring(customDimensions.DestType),
        FromToValue = tostring(customDimensions.FromTo),
        SourceMountTypeValue = tostring(customDimensions.SourceMountType),
        DestEndpointKindValue = tostring(customDimensions.DestEndpointKind),
        SourceAccountValue = tolower(tostring(customDimensions.SourceStorageAccount)),
        DestAccountValue = tolower(tostring(customDimensions.DestStorageAccount)),
        ClientRegionValue = tostring(client_CountryOrRegion),
        JobStatusValue = tostring(customDimensions.JobStatus),
        TerminalStageValue = tostring(customDimensions.TerminalStage),
        JobErrorCategoryValue = tostring(customDimensions.JobErrorCategory),
        JobErrorCodeValue = tostring(customDimensions.JobErrorCode),
        CommandValue = tostring(customDimensions.Command),
        BytesTransferredValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.bytes_transferred']),
        ObjectsCompletedValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.objects_completed']),
        ObjectsFailedValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.objects_failed']),
        TransfersCompletedValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.transfers_completed']),
        TransfersFailedValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.transfers_failed']),
        JobDurationSecondsValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.job_duration_seconds']),
        JobThroughputMbpsValue = todouble(customMeasurements['azcopy.job_throughput_mbps'])
    | where isnotempty(JobID)
    | summarize
        arg_max(
            timestamp,
            InstallationIDValue,
            InvocationContextValue,
            AzCopyVersionValue,
            OSTypeValue,
            SourceTypeValue,
            DestTypeValue,
            FromToValue,
            SourceMountTypeValue,
            DestEndpointKindValue,
            SourceAccountValue,
            DestAccountValue,
            ClientRegionValue,
            JobStatusValue,
            TerminalStageValue,
            JobErrorCategoryValue,
            JobErrorCodeValue,
            CommandValue),
        BytesTransferred = max(BytesTransferredValue),
        ObjectsCompleted = max(ObjectsCompletedValue),
        ObjectsFailed = max(ObjectsFailedValue),
        TransfersCompleted = max(TransfersCompletedValue),
        TransfersFailed = max(TransfersFailedValue),
        JobDurationSeconds = max(JobDurationSecondsValue),
        JobThroughputMbps = max(JobThroughputMbpsValue)
      by JobID
    | extend
        EndTime = timestamp,
        ActivityDay = startofday(timestamp),
        InstallationID = iif(isempty(InstallationIDValue), 'unknown', InstallationIDValue),
        InvocationContext = iif(isempty(InvocationContextValue), 'unknown', InvocationContextValue),
        AzCopyVersion = iif(isempty(AzCopyVersionValue), 'unknown', AzCopyVersionValue),
        OSType = iif(isempty(OSTypeValue), 'unknown', OSTypeValue),
        SourceType = iif(isempty(SourceTypeValue), 'unknown', SourceTypeValue),
        DestType = iif(isempty(DestTypeValue), 'unknown', DestTypeValue),
        FromTo = iif(isempty(FromToValue), 'unknown', FromToValue),
        SourceMountType = iif(isempty(SourceMountTypeValue), 'unknown', SourceMountTypeValue),
        DestEndpointKind = iif(isempty(DestEndpointKindValue), 'unknown', DestEndpointKindValue),
        ClientRegion = iif(isempty(ClientRegionValue), 'unknown', ClientRegionValue),
        JobStatus = iif(isempty(JobStatusValue), 'unknown', JobStatusValue),
        TerminalStage = iif(isempty(TerminalStageValue), 'unknown', TerminalStageValue),
        JobErrorCategory = iif(isempty(JobErrorCategoryValue), 'none', JobErrorCategoryValue),
        JobErrorCode = iif(isempty(JobErrorCodeValue), 'none', JobErrorCodeValue),
        Command = iif(isempty(CommandValue), 'unknown', CommandValue),
        SourceAccount = SourceAccountValue,
        DestinationAccount = DestAccountValue
);
let DestinationAccountDays = materialize(
    RawFinishedJobs
    | where isnotempty(DestinationAccount)
    | distinct ActivityDay, Account = DestinationAccount
);
let DestinationAccounts = materialize(
    DestinationAccountDays
    | distinct Account
);
let DestinationAccountSet = toscalar(
    DestinationAccounts
    | summarize make_set(Account)
);
let HistoricalAccountProperties = materialize(
    DestinationAccountDays
    | join kind=inner hint.remote=right hint.strategy=broadcast (
        cluster('https://xdataanalytics.westcentralus.kusto.windows.net').database('XDataAnalytics').XStoreAccountPropertiesDaily
        | where TimePeriod between ((startofday(QueryStart) - 3d) .. startofday(QueryEnd))
        | extend Account = tolower(AccountNameWithoutVersion)
        | where Account in (DestinationAccountSet)
        | project
            Account,
            OwnershipSnapshot = TimePeriod,
            HistoricalSubscriptionId = tolower(Subscription),
            StorageRedundancyValue = toupper(tostring(Redundancy)),
            StorageAccountClassValue = tostring(BillingType),
            StorageAccessTierValue = tostring(AccessTier),
            IsHnsEnabledValue = toint(IsHnsEnabled)
        | extend ActivityDayCandidates = range(
            startofday(OwnershipSnapshot),
            startofday(OwnershipSnapshot) + 3d,
            1d)
        | mv-expand ActivityDay = ActivityDayCandidates to typeof(datetime)
        | where ActivityDay between (startofday(QueryStart) .. startofday(QueryEnd))
      ) on ActivityDay, Account
    | summarize arg_max(
        OwnershipSnapshot,
        HistoricalSubscriptionId,
        StorageRedundancyValue,
        StorageAccountClassValue,
        StorageAccessTierValue,
        IsHnsEnabledValue)
      by ActivityDay, Account
);
let CurrentStorageResourcesRemote = materialize(
    cluster('https://argeusarm1pone.eastus.kusto.windows.net').database('AzureResourceGraph').Resources
    | where EnableLiveArgEnrichment
    | where timestamp > ago(60h)
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts'
    | where name in (DestinationAccountSet)
    | summarize arg_max(
        timestamp,
        deleted,
        subscriptionId,
        tenantId,
        location,
        ['kind'],
        sku)
      by Account = tolower(name)
    | project
        Account,
        ResourceSnapshot = timestamp,
        ResourceDeleted = deleted,
        ResourceSubscriptionId = tolower(subscriptionId),
        ResourceTenantId = tolower(tenantId),
        StorageRegionValue = tolower(location),
        StorageKindValue = tostring(['kind']),
        StorageSkuValue = tostring(sku.name),
        StorageSkuTierValue = tostring(sku.tier)
);
let CurrentSubscriptionSet = toscalar(
    CurrentStorageResourcesRemote
    | where isnotempty(ResourceSubscriptionId)
    | summarize make_set(ResourceSubscriptionId)
);
let CurrentArgInventoryRemote =
    CurrentStorageResourcesRemote
    | join kind=leftouter (
        cluster('https://argeusarm1pone.eastus.kusto.windows.net').database('AzureResourceGraph').InternalSubscriptionResources
        | where EnableLiveArgEnrichment
        | where timestamp > ago(60h)
        | where subscriptionId in (CurrentSubscriptionSet)
        | summarize arg_max(timestamp, deleted, properties)
          by ResourceSubscriptionId = tolower(subscriptionId)
        | project
            ResourceSubscriptionId,
            SubscriptionSnapshot = timestamp,
            SubscriptionDeleted = deleted,
            SubscriptionDisplayNameValue = tostring(properties.displayName),
            OfferTypeValue = tostring(properties.offerType),
            SubscriptionChannelValue = tostring(properties.billingProperties.channelType)
    ) on ResourceSubscriptionId
    | project-away ResourceSubscriptionId1;
let CurrentArgInventory = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true
       (
           datatable(
               Account:string,
               ResourceSnapshot:datetime,
               ResourceDeleted:bool,
               ResourceSubscriptionId:string,
               ResourceTenantId:string,
               StorageRegionValue:string,
               StorageKindValue:string,
               StorageSkuValue:string,
               StorageSkuTierValue:string,
               SubscriptionSnapshot:datetime,
               SubscriptionDeleted:bool,
               SubscriptionDisplayNameValue:string,
               OfferTypeValue:string,
               SubscriptionChannelValue:string
           )[]
       ),
       CurrentArgInventoryRemote
);
let CurrentStorageResources = materialize(
    CurrentArgInventory
    | summarize arg_max(
        ResourceSnapshot,
        ResourceDeleted,
        ResourceSubscriptionId,
        ResourceTenantId,
        StorageRegionValue,
        StorageKindValue,
        StorageSkuValue,
        StorageSkuTierValue)
      by Account
    | where ResourceDeleted == false
);
let JobsWithAccountInventory = materialize(
    RawFinishedJobs
    | join kind=leftouter HistoricalAccountProperties
        on ActivityDay, $left.DestinationAccount == $right.Account
    | project-away Account
    | join kind=leftouter CurrentStorageResources
        on $left.DestinationAccount == $right.Account
    | project-away Account
    | extend DestinationSubscriptionId = iif(
        isnotempty(HistoricalSubscriptionId),
        HistoricalSubscriptionId,
        ResourceSubscriptionId)
);
let DestinationSubscriptionSet = toscalar(
    JobsWithAccountInventory
    | where isnotempty(DestinationSubscriptionId)
    | summarize make_set(DestinationSubscriptionId, 100000)
);
let AipddSubscriptionSnapshot = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (
            datatable(
                DestinationSubscriptionId:string,
                AipddFriendlySubscriptionName:string,
                AipddOfferType:string,
                AipddCustomerKey:string,
                AipddCustomerName:string,
                AipddCurrentSubscriptionStatus:string,
                AipddSubscriptionBusinessStatus:string,
                AipddUpdatedAt:datetime
            )[]
        ),
        (
            datatable(SubscriptionGuid:string, FriendlySubscriptionName:string, AI_OfferType:string, TPID:string, TPName:string, CurrentSubscriptionStatus:string, AI_SubscriptionBusinessStatus:string, AI_UpdatedAt:datetime)[]
            | where EnableAipddEnrichment
            | where array_length(DestinationSubscriptionSet) > 0
            | where isnotnull(SubscriptionGuid)
            | extend DestinationSubscriptionId = tolower(tostring(SubscriptionGuid))
            | where DestinationSubscriptionId in (DestinationSubscriptionSet)
            | project
                DestinationSubscriptionId,
                AipddFriendlySubscriptionName = tostring(FriendlySubscriptionName),
                AipddOfferType = tostring(AI_OfferType),
                AipddCustomerKey = tostring(TPID),
                AipddCustomerName = tostring(TPName),
                AipddCurrentSubscriptionStatus = tostring(CurrentSubscriptionStatus),
                AipddSubscriptionBusinessStatus = tostring(AI_SubscriptionBusinessStatus),
                AipddUpdatedAt = todatetime(AI_UpdatedAt)
        )
    | summarize arg_max(
        AipddUpdatedAt,
        AipddFriendlySubscriptionName,
        AipddOfferType,
        AipddCustomerKey,
        AipddCustomerName,
        AipddCurrentSubscriptionStatus,
        AipddSubscriptionBusinessStatus)
      by DestinationSubscriptionId
);
let CurrentSubscriptionInventory = materialize(
    CurrentArgInventory
    | where isnotempty(ResourceSubscriptionId)
    | summarize arg_max(
        SubscriptionSnapshot,
        SubscriptionDeleted,
        SubscriptionDisplayNameValue,
        OfferTypeValue,
        SubscriptionChannelValue)
      by SubscriptionId = ResourceSubscriptionId
    | where SubscriptionDeleted == false
);
let JobsWithSubscriptionInventory = materialize(
    JobsWithAccountInventory
    | join kind=leftouter CurrentSubscriptionInventory
        on $left.DestinationSubscriptionId == $right.SubscriptionId
    | project-away SubscriptionId
);
let EnrichedFinishedJobs = materialize(
    JobsWithSubscriptionInventory
    | join kind=leftouter AipddSubscriptionSnapshot on DestinationSubscriptionId
    | extend DestinationUsesStorageAccount = DestType in ('Blob', 'BlobFS', 'File', 'FileNFS')
    | extend
        DestinationSubscriptionKey = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(DestinationSubscriptionId), 'Unmapped',
            DestinationSubscriptionId),
        DestinationSubscription = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(DestinationSubscriptionId), 'Unmapped',
            isnotempty(AipddFriendlySubscriptionName),
                strcat(AipddFriendlySubscriptionName, ' (', DestinationSubscriptionId, ')'),
            isnotempty(SubscriptionDisplayNameValue),
                strcat(SubscriptionDisplayNameValue, ' (', DestinationSubscriptionId, ')'),
            DestinationSubscriptionId),
        OfferType = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isnotempty(AipddOfferType), AipddOfferType,
            isnotempty(OfferTypeValue), OfferTypeValue,
            not(EnableAipddEnrichment) and not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment),
                'Subscription enrichment disabled',
            'Unknown'),
        CustomerKey = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableAipddEnrichment), 'AIPDD enrichment disabled',
            isempty(AipddCustomerKey), 'Unmapped',
            AipddCustomerKey),
        CustomerName = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableAipddEnrichment), 'AIPDD enrichment disabled',
            isnotempty(AipddCustomerName), AipddCustomerName,
            isnotempty(AipddFriendlySubscriptionName)
                or isnotempty(AipddOfferType)
                or isnotempty(AipddCurrentSubscriptionStatus)
                or isnotempty(AipddSubscriptionBusinessStatus), 'Customer unavailable',
            'Unmapped customer'),
        SubscriptionChannel = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            isempty(SubscriptionChannelValue), 'Unknown',
            SubscriptionChannelValue),
        SubscriptionScope = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            SubscriptionChannelValue =~ 'Internal', 'Internal',
            SubscriptionChannelValue in~ ('CustomerLed', 'FieldLed', 'PartnerLed'), 'External',
            'Unknown'),
        StorageRegion = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            isempty(StorageRegionValue), 'Unmapped',
            StorageRegionValue),
        StorageKind = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            isempty(StorageKindValue), 'Unmapped',
            StorageKindValue),
        StorageSku = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            isempty(StorageSkuValue), 'Unmapped',
            StorageSkuValue),
        StorageRedundancy = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(StorageRedundancyValue), 'Unmapped',
            StorageRedundancyValue),
        StorageNamespace = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isnull(IsHnsEnabledValue), 'Unmapped',
            IsHnsEnabledValue == 1, 'HNS',
            'FNS'),
        StorageAccessTier = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(StorageAccessTierValue), 'Unknown or not set',
            StorageAccessTierValue),
        StorageAccountClass = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(StorageAccountClassValue), 'Unmapped',
            StorageAccountClassValue),
        AccountInventoryStatus = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(DestinationAccount), 'Missing account name',
            isnotempty(OwnershipSnapshot), 'Mapped historical',
            isnotempty(ResourceSnapshot), 'Mapped current only',
            'Missing account inventory'),
        ResourceInventoryStatus = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            isempty(DestinationAccount), 'Missing account name',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            isnotempty(ResourceSnapshot), 'Mapped',
            'Missing current resource inventory'),
        SubscriptionInventoryStatus = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableLiveArgEnrichment), 'Live ARG disabled',
            isempty(DestinationSubscriptionId), 'Missing account inventory',
            isnotempty(SubscriptionSnapshot), 'Mapped',
            'Missing subscription inventory'),
        AipddSubscriptionInventoryStatus = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableAipddEnrichment), 'AIPDD enrichment disabled',
            isempty(DestinationSubscriptionId), 'Missing account inventory',
            isnotempty(AipddFriendlySubscriptionName)
                or isnotempty(AipddOfferType)
                or isnotempty(AipddCurrentSubscriptionStatus)
                or isnotempty(AipddSubscriptionBusinessStatus), 'Mapped',
            'Missing AIPDD subscription'),
        CustomerInventoryStatus = case(
            not(DestinationUsesStorageAccount), 'Not applicable',
            not(EnableAipddEnrichment), 'AIPDD enrichment disabled',
            isempty(DestinationSubscriptionId), 'Missing account inventory',
            isempty(AipddFriendlySubscriptionName)
                and isempty(AipddOfferType)
                and isempty(AipddCurrentSubscriptionStatus)
                and isempty(AipddSubscriptionBusinessStatus), 'Missing AIPDD subscription',
            isnotempty(AipddCustomerKey) and isnotempty(AipddCustomerName), 'Mapped',
            'Subscription mapped, customer unavailable')
);

let FilteredJobs = materialize(
    EnrichedFinishedJobs
    | where isempty('${InstallationID}') or InstallationID =~ '${InstallationID}'
    | where isempty('${Account}')
        or SourceAccount =~ '${Account}'
        or DestinationAccount =~ '${Account}'
    | where $__contains(InvocationContext, ${InvocationContext})
    | where $__contains(SourceType, ${SourceType})
    | where $__contains(DestType, ${DestType})
    | where $__contains(SubscriptionScope, ${SubscriptionScope})
    
);
FilteredJobs
| summarize
    FirstObserved = min(EndTime),
    LastObserved = max(EndTime),
    ActiveMonths = dcount(startofmonth(EndTime)),
    ObservedJobs = dcount(JobID),
    SuccessfulJobs = dcountif(JobID, JobStatus =~ 'Completed' and TransfersFailed == 0),
    DataTB = round(sum(BytesTransferred) / 1e12, 3),
    DestinationAccounts = dcountif(DestinationAccount, isnotempty(DestinationAccount))
  by InstallationID
| where ActiveMonths >= 2
| order by ActiveMonths desc, DataTB desc
| take 500
